subject.title: [Bug] Agent context window fragmentation during concurrent subagent tool calls

question: Should concurrent subagent completions remain immediate push events in completion order, or should OpenClaw introduce parent-turn batching that waits and emits them in spawn order?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically feasible, but batching changes documented latency and orchestration semantics and requires explicit decisions for failures, timeouts, cancellation, nesting, and gateway restarts.

options.title: Keep push-based ordering
options.body: Require a concrete failing transcript and fix any missing correlation metadata or parent synthesis guidance without delaying completed children.

options.title: Add spawn-order batching
options.body: Define a parent-turn batch lifecycle and wait policy so all sibling results flush in invocation order despite slow or failed children.

recommendation.title: Keep push-based ordering
recommendation.body: Require a concrete failing transcript and fix any missing correlation metadata or parent synthesis guidance without delaying completed children.
